0022600003.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons with this game, with the Spurs hosting the Thunder, and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance, who is out after knee surgery, while Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and is a game-time decision. The Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 4-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-3, most recently beating Oklahoma City 111-103 there on May 30, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Spurs a 55% chance of winning.
